verbatim_quotes: This is Officer Daniel Reyes with the Social Security Administration. I'm calling because your social has been suspended due to suspicious activity linked to a vehicle rented in Texas. There is a warrant pending. Now before I can lift the suspension I need to verify the last four of your social, and we need to secure the funds in your account today. The way we do that is you go to CVS and purchase five hundred dollars in Apple gift cards and read me the numbers on the back. Do not hang up this call or discuss this with anyone, that would be obstruction. Is Ian there right now? Can you confirm his home address for the file?
